meta.status: IN FORCE from M1. tools/model_schema.py merges this into docs/phase34-model.json when it loads the contract.
meta.not_included: the evaluator's EvaluationStatus and Holds (M0 section 6): M1 implements no evaluator, so they are not part of the contract yet

StatementMode.note: EXPLICIT: the source states the temporal fact in words. IMPLIED: it follows only from the document's framing (its date, a sheet's vintage, a title year).

CandidateDisposition.note: A property of a candidate within one Reconciliation, not of the Observation.

TransitionKind.note: Provisional name (decision O3; the brief's RELATED_NOT_ESTABLISHED names the same meaning). Related, the relationship not established; always certainty UNRESOLVED.

rules: both bounds are present; each follows the TemporalBound rules
OPEN and NOT_APPLICABLE are not allowed in a window
earliest is not after latest where both are dated
a point event is earliest == latest
TimeWindow.meaning: when a source claims, or the model concludes, an event happened; never the document's publication, retrieval or reconciliation date

IdentityTransition.at.note: a transition has exactly one of at and occurred
